It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.|The Shorekeeper}} The {{Intro/Resonator|Shorekeeper}} She is known as "the Second Instance," the Guardian of the [[Black Shores]], and is a mythical entity composed of [[Sonoro Spheres]] and high-purity [[Remnant]] Energy crystals with the power to guide the [[Tethys System]] and control the stars themselves, only appearing during times of crisis to aid the true leader of the Black Shores. Even among the organization's guests and members, she remains an incredibly enigmatic figure. ==Official Introduction== {{Quote|The Shorekeeper of the Black Shores, a mysterious divine being governing the essence of aloofness, emerges in response to your summon. Having spent eons in guardianship, the first stirrings of emotion and desire awaken within her heart, fostering a firm determination to connect with the world — and with you.|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#resonators Her introduction on the Official Website.] }} In her role as the guardian of the Black Shores, a simple title is all the Shorekeeper needs to explain her existence.
